facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.
Adults undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass; near-infrared spectroscopy-guided monitoring versus control care; postoperative delirium and secondary outcomes.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: RISK_OF_BIAS; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently assess risk of bias with the Cochrane tool across random-sequence generation, allocation concealment, blinding of participants and personnel, blinding of outcome assessment, incomplete outcome data, and selective reporting.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SYNTHESIS_MODEL; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: All Target meta-analyses will use a random-effects model selected before inspecting Study effect estimates, Q, or I² because the eligible Review combines different cardiac operations, cerebral-oxygenation intervention protocols, delirium assessments, and trial-level adverse-outcome definitions.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: HETEROGENEITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: All Target meta-analyses will use a random-effects model selected before inspecting Study effect estimates, Q, or I² because the eligible Review combines different cardiac operations, cerebral-oxygenation intervention protocols, delirium assessments, and trial-level adverse-outcome definitions. Heterogeneity will be assessed with Cochran's Q, using P below 0.10 as significant, and I², with values above 50% considered substantial. Q and I² will describe observed heterogeneity but will not select or change the analysis model. When substantial heterogeneity is present, meta-regression and subgroup analysis will be used to investigate potential sources. If heterogeneity remains unexplained, results will be synthesized descriptively.
